title: Kepler-6 b · an exoplanet transit (Draft)
description: The same plan as Drafts only: a start Card and three Drafts that state what each step takes and gives, ready for the Agent's "Generate Cards".

cards.summary: Fetches the long-cadence light curve (FITS) of Kepler-6 (KIC 10874614), quarter 3, from MAST's Kepler archive and passes it on as a folder. Shows the size and SHA-256 of the files fetched.

notes.html:
The transit method

When a planet crosses in front of its star, the brightness drops by the fraction of the star's disc the planet covers.

δ≈(RpR⋆)2\delta \approx \left(\frac{R_p}{R_\star}\right)^2

Kepler-6 b is a hot Jupiter with a period of about 3.23 days, and a depth of about 1%.

Change window_days of detrend or the range of the period search and rerun just that Card.

intro: A Draft is a Card that says in words what it receives, what it does and what it passes on. It has no code yet. With "Generate Cards" in the app, the Agent writes code from these words, runs it and checks.
